preliminaryDataNote: p.41 footnote: '*Note : les cellules bleues contiennent des données préliminaires'. Blue/preliminary cells rendered as '-' (dash) in the table: indoor Débit d'air (cooling+heating), indoor Filtre à air Type, Puissance absorbée Rafraîchissement/Chauffage Nom., indoor Niveau de puissance sonore Chauffage, Efficacité nominale Consommation énergétique annuelle. These are UNPUBLISHED -> recorded as unknowns, NOT extracted, NOT invented. Outdoor sound pressure row label is 'Nom.' (nominal) only.
soundPressureAmbiguity: Indoor 'Niveau de pression sonore' rows are labelled 'Silence/Bas/Haut' (3 labels) but each cell publishes 4 slash values (e.g. 39/32/25/19*). Exact cell-to-label mapping is ambiguous from text+image; the 4 values were recorded in published order with distinct 'first/second/third/fourth value' conditions and NOT reordered. Asterisk footnote: '+2 dBA en configuration Multi'. Lowest value (19 for 20/25/35, 21 for 42, 24 for 50) matches the marketing blurb 'minimum de 19 dBA'.
airflowUnitNote: Indoor airflow is NOT published on p.41 (dash/preliminary). If a future source publishes m³/min, schema m3/h conversion is x60 (1 m³/min = 60 m³/h).
